messages:
maria: noticing pages not reaching PagerDuty. page-proxy heartbeat missing in logs, customers reporting delayed alerts. anyone oncall?
ajay: on it — checking relay health and pd integration now. what time did this start?
maria: started ~03:04 UTC, noticed a gap of ~90s on our monitor.
ops-bot: ALERT: page-proxy-heartbeat | host=pg-relay-3 | last_seen=6276543120 | dropped_forwarded=27 | action=none
eng-sre: seeing the same. logs show repeated TCP timeouts to pd-ingest: "connect timeout" and backpressure.
lina: i’m primary oncall. if PD isn't getting pages we should manual escalate via SMS for high severity incidents.
ajay: attempting to flip routing to sms-fallback now: `pagerctl route set --service notify-bridge --destination sms-fallback --reason "page-proxy heartbeat miss"`
ajay: manual pages sent via `sms-send --to oncall --message "URGENT: PD integration failing — manual page"` — Lina, did you get those?
lina: got both SMS pages, thanks. responding to impacted incidents.
sara: customers pinged support about missing alerts; ticket numbers: #4681, #4683. please add to incident timeline.
eng-sre: i restarted page-proxy on pg-relay-3: `systemctl restart page-proxy` — watching logs.
ops-bot: LOG: page-proxy[pid=4123] -> connecting to pd-ingest: timeout=2s, retry=3
eng-sre: after restart, heartbeat back. ops-bot shows last_seen=6276543285.
maria: verified PagerDuty receipts for previously dropped events — PD shows inbound at 03:07 UTC. customers with delayed alerts were notified; support updated tickets.
ajay: rolling a short-term mitigation: add a healthcheck that verifies last_forwarded_ts and alerts if >30s.
lina: agreed. also add retry jitter and circuit-breaker metrics to avoid bulk backoff.
sara: posting an incident update to status.redwood.com: "Paging integration degraded 03:04–03:07 UTC; manual SMS escalation used for impacted incidents; root cause investigation ongoing."
maria: good. future action items: (1) add heartbeat alert for forwarder >30s, (2) add automated fallback switch to sms-fallback if PD ack rate drops below threshold, (3) run a postmortem. assigning to me for follow-up.
ajay: I'll draft the playbook steps for manual reroute and SMS escalation.
eng-sre: capturing logs and timeline, will attach to the postmortem.
lina: thumbs up — reopened any active sev tickets and confirmed customer impact minimized by manual pages.
maria: thanks everyone. filing post-incident follow-up and scheduling a retro. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: NOTICE: incident resolved (page-proxy restarted). metrics -> pd_ack_rate back to normal.
